singapore.title: CNA Now: ASEAN leaders meet in Manila, plus other news as it happens
singapore.summary: Stay on top of the day's biggest stories with CNA Now, which brings you breaking news and major developments from Singapore and around the world.

singapore.title: A positive HPV test does not mean you have cervical cancer. Here's what to know
singapore.summary: Most human papillomavirus (HPV) infections clear naturally, but some strains can cause changes in cervical cells that may eventually lead to cancer. Doctors explain when an infection becomes a concern, who is at greater risk and why regular screening matters.

singapore.title: 'Not enough to make a good game anymore': Singapore game developers flail as pressures, risks intensify
singapore.summary: French firm Ubisoft in October slashed 70 jobs at its Singapore studio. Experts and developers say the cuts reflect broader struggles for the local gaming scene.

singapore.title: Cyclist killed in Changi tipper truck accident identified as national triathlete Russell Lee
singapore.summary: "At just 24 years old, Russell was a dedicated student-athlete and a cherished member of our national squad," said the Triathlon Association of Singapore.

singapore.title: Singapore-Indonesia haze task force should become ASEAN-wide platform: PM Wong
singapore.summary: He also urged restraint over Thailand-Cambodia border tensions and said Myanmar must show "concrete actions" before returning fully to the regional bloc.

singapore.title: What should ASEAN focus on amid global uncertainty? PM Wong suggests 3 areas

singapore.title: A family photo, a hand to hold: An occupational therapist learnt what matters most to dying patients
singapore.summary: Some patients worry less about dying than about the loved ones they will leave behind. For St Luke’s Hospital occupational therapist Esther Lim, caring for people nearing the end of life has revealed their regrets, surprisingly simple wishes and moments of joy.

singapore.title: 'Very inconvenient': Residents, shop owners frustrated by indiscriminately parked bicycles despite stepped-up enforcement

singapore.title: A Tiong Bahru apartment gets a warm, Scandinavian-inspired makeover
singapore.summary: An 89-sq-m apartment in one of Singapore’s oldest housing estates has been transformed into a light-filled home with an open layout, natural materials and carefully chosen design classics.

singapore.title: Records of about 140,000 migrant workers exposed in Fullerton Health's recent data breach
singapore.summary: About 43,000 records belonged to individuals whose work passes were no longer valid, the healthcare provider said in response to CNA's queries.

singapore.title: PM Wong to visit Manila for ASEAN Summit, related meetings from Nov 15

singapore.title: ASEAN countries sign world's first region-wide digital economy pact, laying foundation for collaboration
singapore.summary: Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong said the pact took several years to negotiate and reflects the diverse state of readiness among member countries.

singapore.title: Singapore authorises carbon credit project to improve safe drinking water access in Rwanda

singapore.title: New Singapore network aims to strengthen last-mile delivery of aid into Gaza with 'reliable partners'
singapore.summary: Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs Zaqy Mohamad, who is on a visit to Egypt, says there are still logistical challenges in getting aid into Gaza.

singapore.title: Singapore government’s Outlook services fully restored after global Microsoft outage
